title: Simplicity Ain't Easy - Stuart Halloway
summary: Stuart Halloway argues that simplicity is objective, with a definition and etymology useful to programmers, rather than a subjective buzzword. He shows how this view informs Clojure's design and how to make programs simpler.
why: HN commenters recommend it, alongside Rich Hickey's talk, for its precise definition of simple versus easy and its implications for code design.

quote.text: He talks about his definition of "simple" (by digging into what the original English definition was) and what that means for code.
